rules.behavior: Audit only; reject wrong architecture. Never guess a replacement.
Source-dependent: keep correct x64 file; wrong architecture requires legitimate x64 input and a new audit.
Test supplied runtime first; native override only on dependency/failure evidence.

Only exact stock hash, absent export, known runtime and explicit request permit guarded patch. Exact patched hash is a no-op. Unknown export absence requires engineering; export presence requires native behavior testing.
Audit categories and StyleTemplate; missing content blocks launch. Matching source preferred.
Mixed 26.2 content with 26.1.252 is a tested local exception, not a rule for future versions.
192 DPI and HIGHDPIAWARE require Qt/CEF and pointer testing; prefer simpler settings if validated.
Classic/MSAA8 only where supported; never silently substitute software rendering.
Wine/X11 raster and window styles are version dependent. Re-test helper eligibility, first paint and focus after framework/runtime changes.

Use existing host CA policy with TLS verification. Revalidate Wine host-root import and embedded Ruby default-store bootstrap after changes; require core network/account gates. Never transfer Windows credentials.
REQUIRES_AUDIT; generic preparation allowed, old fixes never applied blindly.
